div.style: color: rgb(31, 60, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A Subscription's payer is always its own beneficiary now — billable_owner
and beneficiary are the same record (see Subscription#beneficiary).
A third party funding someone else's access does so through a separate
Sponsorship + Monetary Contribution, crediting the beneficiary's own
Stripe balance. It never reassigns who owns a Subscription.

div.style: color: rgb(35, 24, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
